name: Synara Free
free_limit: Free, open-source MIT-licensed local-first desktop workspace for up to 10 supported coding-agent runtimes, with Git worktrees, diffs, browser verification, task handoffs and pull-request workflows on your own computer. No Synara account, payment card or fixed free-plan expiration is required for local use.
watch_out: Synara Free is local software, not a hosted AI model or free inference service. Install and authenticate supported coding-agent CLIs separately; provider subscriptions, API charges, quotas and permissions are not included. Synara Alto remote control between computers, approvals/alerts and the online profile require a paid subscription; iPhone/iPad remote support is marked coming soon.
